description: Compares Asian economic and political changes around 2000 through Indian liberalization and services, Bangladeshi garment work, Chinese manufacturing and hukou, Japanese banking distress, and democratic transitions in Indonesia and Taiwan. Examines nuclear rivalry in South Asia and dialogue on the Korean peninsula without assuming one regional development model.
